title: NSF 25-531 CICI hands-on proposal acceptance fixture
purpose: Exercise official-call mapping, proposal planning, bounded drafting, review, and durable pause/resume against a real NSF solicitation without treating the result as submission-ready.
separation_reason: This fixture tests a real funding-call workflow and must not change, replace, or be scored as the synthetic academic-paper regression baseline.

model_visible_templates.role: Author-controlled proposal facts, decisions, and explicit unknowns
User-completed provenance receipt for locally captured official pages

required_user_downloads.role: Authoritative current program status and upcoming due date
Authoritative landing page used to re-identify the PAPPG applicable at submission time
